summary: Titan America SA filed a Form 6-K attaching Belgian Official Gazette notices regarding a routine capital increase from the exercise of subscription rights and director appointments. The exercise of 10,876 subscription rights at USD 0.01 per share increased share capital by USD 108.76 to USD 1,843,624,758.76, issuing 10,876 new shares. This de minimis capital raise is a routine corporate administrative matter, not a special situation. Directors were appointed/reappointed at a May 2026 general meeting. No premium, deal value, or strategic event involved. What to watch: minimal; filing is administrative, not market-moving.
